title: Global Supply Chain & Logistics Director
description: Direct end-to-end supply chain strategies, warehouse management, freight procurement, and multi-modal logistics networks.
details:
### Role Overview
Seeking a seasoned Supply Chain Director to manage nationwide logistics networks, vendor procurement, and strategic inventory positioning.

### Key Responsibilities
- Optimize supply chain workflows, freight routing, and warehouse inventory management.
- Negotiate contracts with international shipping, air freight, and last-mile delivery providers.
- Implement supply chain analytics and ERP software tracking for real-time shipment monitoring.

### Requirements
- Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or MBA in Operations.
- 7+ years of leadership in large-scale supply chain, freight forwarding, or distribution management.
